name: SA-Solver PECE
plain: Same solver with use_pece on: after correcting, the model is evaluated again at the corrected state and that replaces the latest history entry. This roughly doubles model calls. The name is a preset of sa_solver.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
As SA-Solver, plus D_i←model(x_corrected,σ) after each corrector, replacing the newest history entry. The corrector also runs on the last step when σ'=0.

props.final_sigma0: σ'=0: x_pred=D from the re-evaluated corrected state.
props.flow_const: half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr: λ=−log σ normally, λ=log((1−σ)/σ) on CONST; α=σe^{λ} (1 normally, 1−σ on CONST). First σ≥1 on CONST replaced by percent_to_sigma(1e-4); s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: SamplerSASolver with use_pece=true reaches the same code.
